name: hcapp_updateRunPhotoEditedBlob
description: Saves the URL of a Hash-Flash-edited (cropped) version of a run photo. Writes only KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl — the original BlobUrl is never modified; callers should always start a re-edit from BlobUrl. If the run's cover (HC.Event.EventCoverPhotoUrl, a COPY of the chosen photo's URL) currently holds this photo's original or previous edit, it is re-pointed at the new edit (2026-09-12); a cover showing another photo is left alone. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 48). Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'editPhoto' for @kennelId (else 1334 / 3). @photoId + @kennelId must match a row (else 4040 / 3). Since 2026-10-13 the photo row and the run's cover copy are updated in one transaction (photo row read WITH UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK); the not-found branch rolls back before logging.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the photo. Used for auth scope and included in the UPDATE WHERE clause. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1234, errorType 2). Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: photoId
parameters.description: Photo to update. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1234, errorType 2). If the combination of @photoId + @kennelId matches no row (@@ROWCOUNT=0 after UPDATE), a 'Photo not found' error is returned (errorCode 4040, errorType 3). Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: editedBlobUrl
parameters.description: Blob URL of the cropped/edited version. Must be non-empty (LEN check after LTRIM/RTRIM). Triggers a validation error if empty or whitespace-only. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always present. Failure: success = 0 with ValidateAppAuth codes, 1234 / 2 missing parameter, 1334 / 3 not authorised, 4040 / 3 photo not found, 1933 / 5 unhandled. Success: success = 1, errorCode / errorType NULL.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. NULL on success.

rowsets.description: Returned only on auth, validation, photo-not-found, role check, or unhandled DB error. Not present on success.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.KennelPhotos SET EditedBlobUrl = @editedBlobUrl, UpdatedAt = GETUTCDATE() WHERE id = @photoId AND KennelId = @kennelId.

UPDATE HC.Event SET EventCoverPhotoUrl = @editedBlobUrl for the photo's run, only when the cover currently equals this photo's BlobUrl or previous EditedBlobUrl. Fires the Event updatedAt trigger, so the run re-syncs.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on validation failure, refusal, not found, or unhandled error.

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: errorType 3 used for both refusal and not-found
codeSmells.detail: Lines 97 and 129: a permission refusal (1334) and a missing photo (4040) share errorType 3; other SPs use 13 for refusals.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
